_comment: Fake creatives for the sponsored-links dev server. Edited live: the server re-reads this file on every request. A creative applies to any link whose host is one of `domains` or a subdomain of one; when several match, one is chosen at random per request. Omit bannerUrl/logoUrl to get generated SVG art in the `accent` color — or drop a file named <slug>-banner.* / <slug>-logo.* into ./assets/ to use real art. `clickUrl` is where the creative body sends a click (default: the dev server's own /campaign/<slug> page). `did`/`handle` are optional; use a real handle to make the sponsor link resolve in the app.

creatives.text: Online meetings that don't make you angry.
We bring democracy to the internet.
